name: k8s_namespace
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes Namespace.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this namespace.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Kubernetes namespace. Must be a DNS-1123 label (lowercase alphanumeric and '-', starting and ending with an alphanumeric, matching ^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$), 1-63 characters, and unique within the cluster.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description. Namespaces are immutable, so changing this forces replacement.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this namespace belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group (EKS cluster) this namespace belongs to.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this namespace to a cloud provider account. Inherited from the resource group.

attributes.name: delete_protection
attributes.description: Guards the namespace against teardown. The platform enables this on every new namespace unless the request says otherwise, and while it is enabled the API refuses both deprovision and delete — so `terraform destroy` fails by design. To tear the namespace down, set this to false and `terraform apply` first, then destroy. Leave it unset to inherit the platform default (enabled). Stored as the `delete_protection` metadata key; it is the only namespace field that can change in place — every other change replaces the namespace.

attributes.name: k8s_namespace_id
attributes.description: ID of this namespace, for reference by dependent resources.
